decisions.reason: As a technically related component line with likely low incremental carrying cost, it still fits the firm's drainage platform well enough to retain despite reduced novelty by 2022.

Floor-level shower drainage is central to the firm's strategic direction in modern bathroom and renovation solutions, so management would be very unlikely to withdraw it if it remains on the market in 2022.
The integrated sloped shower element strengthens the installation system around floor-level showers and remains a complementary option worth keeping in the portfolio.

This backflow-protected basement drain is a more niche and less strategic offering than the shower lines, but its clear problem-solving use case and overlap with the firm's drainage know-how still justify keeping it for now.
